text:
zane: Quick sync: thinking about a `rollback_snapshot` flow for runtime config so we can safely move cohorts back to a known-good snapshot without toggling global flags. idea: cohort-scoped rollback + dry_run preview + audit event. thoughts?
luis: +1 for cohort granularity. naming nit: `rollback_snapshot` vs `undo_to_snapshot`? both are clear, avoid `withdraw` bc ppl confuse with delete.
maya: requires explicit `snapshot_id` and a compatibility pass that runs against current model/variant registry. reject if snapshot references missing model variants unless `allow_mapping` is true.
ana: ana: UX: modal should surface a tiny inline diff (rules added/removed), estimate delta traffic (tokens/sec), and allow selecting notification hooks. Also show recent rollbacks for this flag.
infra: Ops note: risk of rollback storms. propose policy: if rollback affects >30% traffic in a single operation then require 2 approvers and set a 15m post-rollback soft-lock to prevent rapid reverts. also add a per-team cooldown config.
zane: API sketch (draft): ```json
{
  "op": "rollback_snapshot",
  "flag_id": "edge-cache-ttl",
  "snapshot_id": "snap-2026-03-10-2042",
  "scope": "cohort:canary-7",
  "dry_run": true,
  "allow_mapping": false,
  "notify_on": ["impact>5%", "errors>5x"],
  "reason": "post-deploy latency spike"
}
```
luis: dry_run should return a `preview` object with: sample routing table, estimated token/sec change, and a list of incompatible keys if any. console can surface a red/amber/green compatibility indicator.
maya: telemetry: emit `config.rollback.requested` and `config.rollback.applied` with fields {flag_id, from_snapshot, to_snapshot, scope, actor, dry_run, impact_estimate}. create a short alert: if p50 latency > +12% or error_rate +4% within 10m -> auto-suggest roll-forward and page on-call.
ana: ana: can we also include a small timeline widget in modal showing prior 1h metrics for that cohort so approvers see context? I'll wire into the mock.
infra: add guardrail: deny automated rollbacks that would map to deprecated backend services unless `override_deprecation` present and owner sign-off logged.
zane: good call. also: audit trail should include a machine-readable `decision_id` and link to the incident/ticket when present.
luis: testing: add integration test that creates a snapshot, mutates routing, runs dry_run and asserts preview matches simulated traffic. unit test for compatibility mapping too.
ops-bot: deploybot: FYI config-service v2.15.0 will add `/v1/configs/rollback` + preview API on 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC. :robot_face:
maya: owners: API + server impl -> luis, UX + modal -> ana, telemetry & alerts -> infra, runbook -> maya. i'll open tracker: https://redwood/issue/PLAT-rollback-456
ana: ana: will attach Figma screens and the modal interaction notes once deploy is merged.
zane: let's finalize names in RFC; i'll start a short doc for approval rules + team cooldown defaults. thanks all. :thumbsup:
